Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:1.hebrew: אין ממתינין לה עד שתלד - אלא הורגין ולדה עמה, דחד גופא הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:1.english: [The court] does not wait for her until she gives birth - Rather, they kill her fetus with her, for it is one body.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:2.english: [If] she sat on the birthstool - Before her verdict was finalized.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:3.hebrew: ממתינין לה עד שתלד - דכיון דעקר ונע ממקומו, גופא אחרינא הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:3.english: [The court] waits for her until she gives birth - For since [the fetus] has uprooted and moved from its place, it is a separate body.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:4.english: [One may] derive benefit from her hair - And in the Gemara, [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:5.hebrew: אסורה בהנאה - כדקי"ל (פסחים דף כב:): "ובעל השור נקי" — כאדם שאומר לחבירו: "יצא פלוני נקי מנכסיו, ואין לו בהן הנאה של כלום":
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:11:5.english: [It is] forbidden to derive benefit [from it] - As is established for us (Pesachim 22b): "And the owner of the ox shall be clear" — like a person who says to his fellow: "So-and-so came out cleared of his property, and he has no benefit whatsoever from it."

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:13:1.hebrew: לרבות את הולד - קס"ד: משניהם יליף, מדה"ל למיכתב "ומתו", ואנא ידענא דאין "ומתו" פחות משנים:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:13:1.english: To include the fetus - [The Gemara] initially thought that he derives it from "both of them," since [the verse] should have written "and they shall die," and I would know that "and they shall die" is no fewer than two.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:13:2.english: "Both of them" - [This word] is superfluous for an exposition.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:14:1.hebrew: שניהן שוין - הנואף והנואפת יהו בני עונשין, אבל אם היתה היא קטנה והוא גדול, או הוא קטן דלאו בר עונשין והיא גדולה ובת עונשין — אין הגדול נהרג. ומשני: אנו מ"גם" ילפינן:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:14:1.english: Both of them are equal - The adulterer and the adulteress must [both] be subject to punishment, but if she was a minor and he was an adult, or he was a minor who is not subject to punishment and she was an adult who is subject to punishment — the adult is not executed. And [the Gemara] answers: We derive [this] from "gam" [also].

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:16:1.hebrew: לידי ניוול - שאם יהא חיות בולד, יצא לאחר מיתת אמו, וניוול הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:16:1.english: To disgrace - For if there is vitality in the fetus, it will emerge after its mother's death, and [this] is a disgrace.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:1.hebrew: נוחל - אם נפלה לו ירושה בו ביום, ובו ביום מת, מנחילה לקרוביו מאביו:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:1.english: [He] inherits - If an inheritance fell to him on that [same] day, and on that [same] day he died, he bequeaths it to his paternal relatives.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:2.hebrew: ואמר רב ששת - האי "נוחל ומנחיל" ליכא לאוקומי בנכסי אביו, דא"נ לא אתיליד איהו — הוו ירתי קרוביו נכסי אביו, היכא דאין בנים:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:2.english: And Rav Sheshet said - This [ruling of] "inherits and bequeaths" cannot be established [as referring to] his father's property, for even if he had not been born, his relatives would have inherited his father's property where there are no [other] sons.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:3.hebrew: אלא נוחל בנכסי אמו - אם מתה בו ביום, ואפי' הוא מת בו ביום — נוחל נכסי אמו ומנחילן מכחו לאחיו מאביו, שאינן בני אמו; דאי לאו הוא, הוו ירתי לה קרוביה, ולא אמרי': נפל הוא ואינו בן נחלה:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:17:3.english: Rather, [he] inherits his mother’s property - If she died on that day, and even if he died on that day, he inherits his mother’s property and bequeaths it through his power to his paternal brothers, who are not his mother’s children; for were it not for him, her relatives would have inherited [from] her, and we do not say: He is a non-viable newborn and is not eligible to inherit.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:18:1.hebrew: אבל עובר - אם מתה מעוברת, לא ירתי לה קרובי העובר, דהוא מת ברישא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:18:1.english: But a fetus - If a pregnant woman dies, the relatives of the fetus do not inherit from her, because it dies first.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:19:1.hebrew: ומשני ה"מ - דהוא מיית ברישא, לגבי מיתה — כשהיא מתה מיתת עצמה:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:19:1.english: And [the Gemara] answers: "These matters" - [Namely,] that it dies first; "with regard to death" — when she dies of her own death [i.e., of natural causes].

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:1:1.english: By inference that the first tanna holds, etc. - [This is said] in astonishment.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:20:1.hebrew: ופרכינן: וגבי מיתה, מי מיית הוא ברישא? והא הוה עובדא, ופרכיס לאחר מיתת אמו:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:20:1.english: And we object: And regarding [natural] death, does [the fetus] die first? But there was an incident where it twitched after the death of its mother.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:20:2.hebrew: זנב הלטאה - אם חותכין אותה, מפרכסת החתיכה, ואע"פ שאין בה חיות:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:20:2.english: The tail of the lizard - If one cuts it off, the [severed] piece twitches, even though there is no life in it.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:21:1.english: And [one] tears open her abdomen - For sometimes it happens that she dies first.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:4:1.english: And killed him - The ox killed the digger.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:4:2.english: [He is] exempt - The owner of the ox.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:4:3.hebrew: חייבין לשלם - אלמא מלוה הכתובה בתורה ככתובה בשטר דמיא, וקשיא למאן דאוקי פלוגתייהו דרבי יוסי ות"ק דמתני' באם הזיק, דא"כ קשיא סתמא אסתמא. ואיכא דמותיב הך תיובתא לר"ש בן אלעזר, אבל פליאה בעיני: היאך יכול להקשות? הא ר"ש תנא הוא ופליג:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:4:3.english: [They are] liable to pay - Evidently, a loan written in the Torah is considered like [one] written in a document. And [this] poses a difficulty for the one who established the dispute between Rabbi Yosei and the first tanna of our Mishnah [as being] regarding [a case where] he caused damage, for if so, one anonymous [source] contradicts another anonymous [source]. And there are those who raise this objection against Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar, but it is astonishing to me: How could [the Gemara] raise an objection [against him]? Behold, Rabbi Shimon is a tanna, and he disputes [it]!

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:5:1.hebrew: בשעמד בדין - קודם שמת, וחייבוהו לשלם. לפיכך גובה מן היורשין, דכיון דדינו חרוץ לשלם, ה"ל כמלוה בשטר:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:5:1.english: [Where] he stood in judgment - Before he died, and [the court] obligated him to pay. Therefore, [the claimant] collects from the heirs, for since his judgment was finalized to pay, it is [considered] like a loan with a deed.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:6:1.hebrew: והא תני חגא מת וקברו - השור בבור, כגון שהפיל עמו חוליא, ואפ"ה חייבין יורשין:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:6:1.english: "But didn't Chagga teach: '[The ox] died and was buried'?" - [This refers to] the ox in the pit, for example, where it knocked down a mound of earth with it [which buried it], and even so, the heirs are liable.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:6:2.hebrew: והילכתא - הא דקתני יורשין חייבין — כגון דייתבי דייני אפומא דבירא, וחייבוהו מיד לשלם:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:6:2.english: And the halakha - That which [the baraita] teaches, [that the] heirs are liable — [is in a case] such as where judges sat at the mouth of the pit and immediately obligated him to pay.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:1.hebrew: מזין עליו - זורקין בשבילו דם חטאתו ואשמו, ולא הויא כחטאת שמתו בעליה, כל זמן שלא נהרג:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:1.english: [They] sprinkle on his behalf - They dash the blood of his sin-offering and his guilt-offering on his behalf, and it is not like a sin-offering whose owner died, as long as he has not been executed.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:2.hebrew: חטא - בשוגג, באותה שעה שיצא ליהרג, כגון שראה חלב וכסבור שומן הוא, ואכלו:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:2.english: [If] he sinned - Unwittingly, at that time when he went out to be executed; for example, where he saw [forbidden] fat and thought it was [permitted] fat, and ate it.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:3.english: [The court] does not attend to him - That he should designate an offering to be sacrificed.

Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:4.hebrew: מפני שאין מענין את דינו - שימתינו מלהורגו עד שישחטו הזבח ויזרק הדם, שעינוי הדין הוא:
Rashi on Arakhin 7a:7:4.english: Because one does not delay his judgment - [That is,] that they would wait to execute him until they slaughter the sacrifice and the blood is sprinkled, for that is an affliction of judgment.

Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:11:1.hebrew: ישבה על המשבר כו' - פרש"י: "קודם שנגמר דינה". וליתא, דאיוצא ליהרג קאי; וכל היוצא ליהרג — לאחר גמר דין, כדמשמע בכל הנהו דמדכר לעיל במתני' בשמעתין, וכן משמע בפ' כל הגט (גיטין דף כח:) דמדבר ביוצא לידון ויוצא ליהרג. והיינו טעמא דרישא דאין ממתינין — משום עינוי הדין (כלל), כדמשמע פרק אחד דיני ממונות (סנהדרין דף לה.) דליכא עינוי הדין אלא לאחר גמר דין, מדקאמר: היכי ליעביד? לדייניה במעלי שבתא, ולגמר דיניה בשבתא, וליקטליה בחד בשבתא — נמצא אתה מענה את דינו וכו'. ליגמר דיניה בחד בשבתא? קא מנשו לטעמייהו; ולעינוי לא חיישינן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:11:1.english: "She sat on the travailing chair, etc." - Rashi explained: "Before her verdict was finalized." And this is not so, for it refers to [a woman who is] going out to be executed; and anyone who goes out to be executed is after the final verdict, as is implied in all those [cases] mentioned above in the Mishnah [and] in our sugya, and so it is implied in chapter Kol HaGet (Gittin 28b), which speaks of "one who goes out to be judged" and "one who goes out to be executed." And that is the reason of the first clause [of the Mishnah], that [the court] does not wait — because of affliction of judgment [innui hadin] (at all) — as is implied in chapter Echad Dinei Mamonot (Sanhedrin 35a), that there is no affliction of judgment [innui hadin] except after the final verdict, from that which [the Gemara] says: "How should [the court] act? Should they judge him on the eve of Shabbat, finalize his verdict on Shabbat, and execute him on the first day of the week [Sunday]? You would be afflicting his judgment! Etc. Should they finalize his verdict on the first day of the week? They will forget their reasoning!" And [we see that prior to the final verdict] we do not worry about affliction [innui hadin].

Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:4:1.hebrew: מיתיבי בור ברה"ר - לרבה פריך, דאמר לעיל: מצוה הכתובה בתורה לאו ככתובה בשטר דמיא — וכן העתיק ר"ת בספרו. ומצי נמי למפרך לרב יוסף, דהא סבר נמי שיעבודא לאו דאורייתא; אלא פירש דבריו יותר:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:4:1.english: "They raised an objection: A pit in the public thoroughfare" - [The Gemara] raises the objection against Rabba, who said above [that] an obligation [mitzvah] written in the Torah is not considered like [one] written in a document — and so Rabbeinu Tam transcribed in his book. And [the Gemara] could also have raised the objection against Rav Yosef, for he also maintains that a lien [on property] is not of biblical origin; rather, [Rabba] explained his words in greater detail.

Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:5:1.hebrew: אמר רב אילא א"ר כשעמד בדין - לאו משום קושיא דרבה משני רב הכי, שהרי רבה שנים רבות אחר רב היה; אלא משום דפרכינן ליה מיניה בפרק גט פשוט (ב"ב דף קעה:), דאמר התם דמלוה על פה אינו גובה מן היורשין, ולנפשיה משני:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:5:1.english: "Rav Ila said [that] Rav said: Where he stood trial" - It is not because of the objection against Rabba that Rav answers this, for Rabba [lived] many years after Rav; rather, [it is] because we raised an objection against him from it in chapter Get Pashut (Bava Batra 175b), where he said there that [a creditor with] an oral loan cannot collect from the heirs, and he answered for himself [to resolve the challenge to his own position].

Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:6:1.hebrew: דיתבי דייני אפומא דבירא - ומ"מ איצטריך למימר "מת וקברו", דס"ד דבעינן "יבא בעל השור ויעמוד על שורו" (סנהדרין דף יט.); קמ"ל דשפיר עמד עליה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:6:1.english: "[Where] the judges sat at the opening of the pit" - And nevertheless, it was necessary [for the baraita] to state "he died and they buried him," for [otherwise] it might enter your mind to say that we require: "Let the owner of the ox come and stand over his ox" (Sanhedrin 19a) [i.e., that the defendant must physically appear in court]; [therefore,] it comes to teach us that he is well considered to have "stood over it" [since the judges sat at the opening of the pit].

Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:7:1.hebrew: מזין עליו מדם חטאתו ומדם אשמו - דאין חטאת [ואשם] קריבה לאחר מיתתו, אבל עולתו קריבה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 7a:7:1.english: "They sprinkle on his behalf from the blood of his sin offering and from the blood of his guilt offering" - For a sin offering [and a guilt offering] is not sacrificed after his death, but his burnt offering is sacrificed [even after his death].
